adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration determines `category_id` via `INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'`, which is an exact (and in typical Postgres setups, case-sensitive) match against `categories.name`. If the stored site setting value differs in case from `categories.name` (e.g. `blog` vs `Blog`), the query returns no rows, `category_id` becomes 0, and the migration falls back to `uncategorized_category_id`, losing the intended mapping during migration. The finding’s additional claim about “crashes instead of falling back” is not supported by this diff (the migration explicitly falls back), but the category-mapping loss risk is diff-grounded.
